explanation: He had seven children with his first wife, Maria Barbara, and 13 with his second, Anna Magdalena. Only ten reached adulthood, and sons such as Carl Philipp Emanuel became famous composers.

claims.text: Bach had seven children with Maria Barbara Bach and 13 with Anna Magdalena Bach.
Ten of Bach's 20 children survived to adulthood.
Several of Bach's sons, including Carl Philipp Emanuel Bach, became famous composers.

writerNotes: Self-check (§9.3). Lint: clean under content:check for writer w-pmusic02w. Volatility: evergreen; no time words, and nothing depends on knowledge newer than mid-2026. Regional: Bach is known worldwide, and the surprise needs no local knowledge. Style: Oxford spelling, straight quotes, no en or em dashes, explanation within 35 words. Myths: screened against content/reference/myths.json, no hit. Mystery: not applicable to a practice item.
